note: Govt monthly/weekly releases. Main figures sources se verified; headlines roz auto-update (Google News). Indicative only - not advice.

ind.name: GST Collections
ind.sub: gross · Aug 2026 · net ₹1.68 lakh cr · record ₹2.43 (Apr-26) vs ₹1.87 (Apr-23) = +30% 3 saal me
ind.why: High GST = desh me consumption strong. Consumption zyada to company sales aur profit badhta hai.
ind.impact: Bullish: FMCG (HUL, ITC), auto, retail; banks bhi

ind.name: Railway Freight
ind.sub: loading · Aug 2026 · iron ore +12.1%, coal +6%, containers +9.2%
ind.why: Coal, steel, cement freight badhna = industrial activity real-time pulse. GDP leading indicator.
ind.impact: Bullish: NTPC, Coal India, Tata Steel, JSW, cement stocks

ind.name: Port Traffic
ind.sub: Aug 2026 · JNPT record 8.32 lakh TEU (+19.5%) · Mundra record 18.6 MT · APSEZ 50 MMT (+19%)
ind.why: Import-export ka proxy. Container traffic badhna = trade strong. Export companies ka leading indicator.
ind.impact: Bullish: Adani Ports, Concor; exporters ko dekho

ind.name: Auto Sales (SIAM/FADA)
ind.sub: retail · Aug 2026 · Maruti domestic +34.8%, Tata PV +59% · CNG+hybrid+EV ab 42% share (petrol se zyada pehli baar)
ind.why: Monthly sales numbers results se pehle mil jaate hain - stock move karne se pehle trend pakdo.
ind.impact: Bullish: Maruti, Tata Motors, M&M; Bajaj/TVS 2W bhi

ind.name: EPFO Jobs
ind.sub: wage ceiling ₹15k → ₹25k · 16 Sep 2026 · 7.98 cr members total
ind.why: Formal jobs badhna = employment health. RBI bhi ye data dekhta hai. Consumption ka long-term signal.

ind.name: Power Demand
ind.sub: peak · 10 Sep 2026 · highest-ever Sep · 5-saal: 2021 ~200 GW → ab 270 GW (+35%) · May-24 250 → May-26 270
ind.why: Power consumption = industrial activity + GDP growth ka proxy. Sep 1-9 consumption +20.7% YoY.
ind.impact: Bullish: NTPC, Power Grid, Tata Power, coal stocks

ind.name: GDP Growth
ind.why: Desh ki total kamai. GDP badhe to company earnings badhti hain - sab stocks ka pita-mata. World me sabse tez bade economy me se ek.

ind.name: Inflation (CPI)
ind.sub: Aug 2026 · food 5.95% · 3 mahine se badha (May 3.93 → Aug 4.82) · rate hike ka risk
ind.why: Mehngai badhna = RBI rate hike ka darr = loans mehnge = market ko pasand nahi. Kam inflation = rate cut ka hope = bull run ka fuel.
ind.impact: Careful: banks, realty, auto (loans wale); FMCG defensive better
